messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert auto-created: INC-9032 — hosted-api-prod: 5xx rate > 2% over 3m. Paging: @oncall-eng

maria: Seeing a clear spike across model-frontends, lots of gateway 504s. Checking edge-gateway-us-east and KV cache errors.

ash: I can reproduce on the frontends — 5xx increases line up with gateway timeouts to edge-gateway. Thinking routing/backoff to standby region.

devon: Spinning up +2 nodes on dedicated-pool and enabling prefix-cache bypass for the suspect shards. ETA ~4m.

sam: This 5xx alert is noisy — fires on short blips. Recommend suppressing paging until sustained for 5m and add gateway correlation.

maria: For immediate mitigation I'll silence pager for 15m and keep channel notifications only so we can stabilize without escalations.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: silenced for 15m by maria

ryan: Pushed temporary routing policy to route heavy requests >1024 tokens to model-small-2 in eu-west-1 as a fallback.

ash: Traffic reroute complete. 5xx down to ~0.4% but p95 latency still elevated.

sam: Proposed alert rule (draft):
```yaml
expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{status=~"5..",job="hosted-api"}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="hosted-api"}[5m])) > 0.02
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: page
```
Also: require matching upstream gateway 5xx > 1% before page.

devon: I'll open a dashboard PR: name `prod/hosted-api/observability-post-INC-9032`. Will add panels for 5xx rate, gateway latency, kv-cache hitrate and an annotation track of the routing changes.

maria: Postmortem owners: eng-sre (ash), runtime (devon), product (ryan). Schedule 60m review tomorrow 10:00 PT. Action items: update runbook to include 'suppress pager for <10m when deploying routing fallback' and add explicit KV-cache bypass verification steps.

sam: Also recommending threshold tuning: make 5xx paging threshold 2% for high-volume, low-customer-impact routes; keep 1% for customer-facing critical routes (per-route flag).

ryan: I'll file ticket for per-route pager flags and tag top-10 routes by revenue for stricter monitoring.

ash: Any confirmed customer impact? Support notes show two customers reported intermittent timeouts, no data loss.

maria: Impact summary: degraded latency and retries for large-batch embedding jobs between 14:03-14:14 UTC — two customers affected. CSMs notified.

devon: Post-stable suggestion: automate rollback of routing policy if 5xx doesn't drop <0.5% within 10m after change.

sam: I'm pushing the alert config change to staging now, will run smoke and merge on green.

incident-bot: Incident INC-9032 status: mitigated — monitoring. Channel will remain open for postmortem notes.

maria: Thanks all, closing pager escalation. Please drop postmortem notes and dashboard link into the incident doc.
